changes_made.explanation: Removed component-specific model names (Indexer/Discriminator/Generator) since these are architectural components of DAMEN. Consolidated output descriptions into a single clear description.
Normalized ROUGE variants to base form as per guidelines. The paper clearly uses ROUGE metrics for evaluation.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation method is used in this paper. The models mentioned (BERT, BART) are used for generation, not post-generation evaluation.
The paper does not mention any human evaluation. All evaluation is performed using automatic metrics (ROUGE).

overall_notes: The paper proposes DAMEN, a multi-document summarization method for medical literature. It clearly addresses NLG (text summarization) and uses ROUGE metrics for evaluation. No human or LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted. The extraction was generally accurate with minor normalization needed.
